prompts.staff: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pickup sprite for a Gothic fantasy 16-bit action game HD pack. Draw ONE elegant upright golden crozier magic staff, a slim long straight dark-gold shaft capped by a compact curled spiral hook, with a small emerald-green jewel held inside the gold curl. Rounded ivory-gold highlights, amber shaded metal, dark bronze edge. Keep the shaft continuous and thick enough to read at final size 16 pixels wide by 32 pixels tall. The spiral head occupies the upper third, the shaft the lower two thirds. Pixel-art painting, bold readable forms, full object centered with transparent margins. No hands, characters, floor, shadows, aura, particles, text, border, extra objects or background. This identical item will also appear in the pause menu.
prompts.sentinel: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent full-body enemy sprite for a Gothic fantasy 16-bit action game HD pack. Reference image is a native animation-layout study, NOT final artwork: follow the THIRD panel's standing pose and the same broad silhouette. Create an imposing crimson armored temple sentinel, a squat heavy magical suit of plate armor. Tiny recessed closed helmet with narrow ivory visor, enormous rounded pauldrons; both short arms held high and out to the sides with heavy clenched gauntlets just below shoulder height. Chest tapers into a narrow armored waist. Two thick articulated legs stand apart, both feet on the same bottom baseline. Rich burgundy-crimson enamel, antique brass edging, restrained ivory highlights and deep wine-black joints. No weapon. Front view with a slight three-quarter turn to the RIGHT. CRITICAL native layout: total footprint is a 96x96 square; wide shoulders/arms occupy ONLY the upper 32 pixels, while everything below that fits in the middle 64 pixels (x16 through79). Arms must NOT hang down alongside hips. Top of helmet and shoulders is almost the same height. Both feet inside the central two-thirds width, no cape or horns outside footprint. Detailed but clean SNES/GBA-style pixel-art painting, strong readable silhouette, coherent anatomy, polished metal. Full body centered, transparent background, no ground shadow, glow, text or frame. Draw one standing pose only; do not recreate the sheet or its captions.
prompts.sentinel_step: Edit this single crimson armored sentinel sprite for one walking-animation phase. Preserve the exact transparent canvas size, the same character, camera, palette, armor details, lighting, body position, right leg and ALL pixels above the waist. Change ONLY the leg on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE, from its upper thigh through its boot: bend its knee and raise that boot by about one-twelfth of the full character height, as a heavy marching step. Keep thigh, knee, shin and boot continuously joined. The raised boot must remain below the knee, sole horizontal, and inside the original central body width. The right foot remains planted at the exact original baseline. Do not move or redraw the head, torso, arms, right leg or background. Transparent background, no extra elements.
prompts.sentinel_attack: Edit this crimson armored sentinel sprite into its chest-cannon attack pose. Preserve exact transparent canvas size, identical character, position, palette, lighting, hips and both legs/feet. Change ONLY the upper body: open a circular dark cannon aperture in the lower center of the breastplate at the waist, surrounded by a brass ring; angle the helmet slightly toward the right; retract the left-side forearm toward the chest and extend the right-side forearm sideways with its hand open. The right open hand lies below shoulder/helmet-top level: leave the outermost upper-right corner transparent. Arms stay HIGH in the upper third of the entire sprite. Preserve the same broad shoulder silhouette and overall width, no projectiles, glow or extra props. Keep the lower torso edges and every leg/foot unchanged for seamless animation. Clean crisp Gothic fantasy pixel-art painting, genuine transparency.
